blocks.title: Crystal lattice
blocks.text: Three-dimensional (3D) space mein ions, atoms ya molecules ke regular (ba-qaida) arrangement ko crystal lattice kehte hain.
Jin solids ki shakal fixed, regular aur three-dimensional geometric ho, unhen crystalline solids kehte hain. Misalein: heera (diamond), sodium chloride (namak), barf (ice) waghera.
